d: Short, messy, bubblegum pink hair with choppy bangs is paired with wide, sparkling crimson eyes and a youthful, cheerful expression on a mature teenage face. The build is slender with a large bust, dressed in a white collared shirt with a pink bow, a dark brown mini-skirt, and a black jacket draped over the shoulders, all accented by yellow and pink details. Accessories include a black beret with a yellow band and a pink bow, dark sunglasses resting on the head, a black headset with a microphone, a pink ID badge, and a complex black utility belt with yellow accents and a grey water bottle.
